text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a couple of customers hit a weird double-charge pattern when a streaming session falls back to a shorter model and then we do an ephemeral snapshot + toolcall truncation.
kevin: hmm can you paste an example session id?
maria: session: s-9a3b; timeline: client opens stream -> routing fallback to small-model for cost -> snapshot persisted mid-stream -> client replays suffix -> toolcall invoked and truncated -> billing shows 2 provisional tokens and 1 confirmed but charged twice.
alyssa: that flow rings a bell. I think our provisional ledger creates an ephemeral snapshot entry and then the final ledger applies confirmed charges without dedupe in some fallbacks.
ranjan: is the duplication happening because snapshot uses a different provenance tag? we tag provisional as "prefix_ephemeral" and confirmed as "toolcall_final" so dedupe rules don't match.
maria: exactly. UI shows provisional: 42 tokens, confirmed: 38 tokens, but customer saw invoice tokens = 80-ish.
billing-bot: [auto] Created provisional charge pch_4870012345 for 42 tokens (prefix_ephemeral).
kevin: quick thought: either align provenance tags across ephemeral snapshots and finalization, or change reconciliation to match by session + token-range overlap. Both have tradeoffs.
alyssa: matching by token-range overlap is fiddly because of truncation — toolcall truncation can shift offsets. But matching by session_id + approximate range should work if we store original prefix hash.
ranjan: can we instead set a grace-window flag: when a provisional snapshot exists within Xs of a confirmed finalize, we auto-mark provisional as superseded and credit-back before invoice materializes?
maria: that matches the proposed console affordance too — show a "grace window" state in the Charges timeline and collapse provisional/confirm pairs.
kevin: implementation wise: BFF should include provisional.ref_id on the finalization request so ledger can call reconcile(ref_id) and do atomic adjust. Does existing finalization call accept an optional provenance_ref?
alyssa: not today. finalization endpoint is POST /ledger/finalize { session_id, confirmed_tokens, model } — no ref. We could add provisional_ref optional.
ranjan: backwards compatibility OK if optional. But for streaming fallbacks we sometimes create multiple provisional snapshots per session — which ref would be used? latest provisional id?
maria: use latest_provisional_id for that session. For safety, ledger reconcile should look up all provisional entries for session within grace window and mark them as superseded while computing net charge.
kevin: OK but need guardrails: if a provisional was from a different path (e.g., different model pinned by customer) we shouldn't auto-adjust. Include model fingerprint and routing tag check.
alia??? wait typo — alyssa: yep include model_hash + routing_tag. If mismatch, skip reconcile and leave provisional.
billing-bot: [auto] Invoice preview generated for s-9a3b: provisional 42, confirmed 38, net pending 80 (needs reconciliation).
maria: UX ask: console should mark preview lines as "pending grace-window" and surface reason: "ephemeral snapshot + toolcall truncation". Customer-facing wording should avoid internal terms.
kevin: action items: 1) API: add optional provisional_ref to finalize (kevin). 2) Ledger: implement reconcile_by_session_with_tags(grace_window=30s) (ranjan). 3) Console: new charge-state "pending-grace" and collapse UI (alyssa). 4) Backfill script to detect likely duplicates in last 24h and issue credits (maria).
ranjan: timeline? can do ledger side in ~2w if no big migrations. Need to be careful with snapshot GC.
kevin: I'll spec the API change today, add tests for idempotency and an integration test with replay/truncation.
alyssa: for the console, I'll mock the preview behavior and show the pending-grace badge. Will coordinate copy with support.
maria: support note: pls tag any affected customers and prepare standard credit message.
billing-bot: [auto] Raised ticket BILL-4870 for backfill credits.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of ledger v2 scheduled for 4870014000-4870014600 UTC.
ranjan: couple edge questions: what if provisional already expired (older than grace window) but finalize comes later? we should not credit then.
kevin: agreed — only reconcile within grace_window threshold. If finalize arrives later, treat as separate confirmed charge; customer may need manual review.
maria: ok let's try to keep grace_window conservative — 30s default, but exposed as org-config in Dedicated.
alyssa: note: telemetry — add a metric provisional_reconciled_count and provisional_unmatched_count, with tags: model_hash, routing_tag.
kevin: good. Also add a console graph for reconciliation rate to help SREs spot degradations.
maria: thanks all. I'll start drafting support template and list of affected sessions. Ping me if you need session exports.
kevin: thanks.
alyssa: :thumbsup:
ranjan: assigning tasks in JIRA now.
maria: closing loop: create small RFC for audit trail — must record any auto-crediting with reason and refs for compliance.
kevin: +1 on RFC.
maria: (end)
